notices.title: Student Code of Conduct
notices.description: Rules and regulations every student must follow on campus, including uniform, ID card, device and discipline guidelines.
notices.details:
1. No student may enter the campus after the scheduled entry time.
2. Every student must carry the designated ID card when entering the institution.
3. Entry without complete school uniform is strictly prohibited.
4. Bringing anything other than study materials (mobile phone, tab, laptop, camera, musical instruments or any other device) is prohibited.
5. Students must not get involved in quarrels or fights with other students. Strict action will be taken against anyone involved.
6. Misbehaviour with teachers will result in action according to the rules.
7. Colour play, birthday celebrations and rag day celebrations are strictly prohibited at any event of the institution.
8. No damage may be done to the infrastructure, furniture, lab equipment, electric fans etc. of the institution.
9. Students may not go outside during class hours without the teacher's permission.
10. As AERE is a KPI area, loitering or gossiping inside the AERE colony without reason before or after classes and during tiffin time is not allowed.
11. Bathing in the institution's pond is strictly prohibited.
12. Students must follow an ideal, student-like code of conduct in personal appearance.
13. Necessary action will be taken against anyone who breaks the rules of the institution.

Principal (Acting)
Atomic Energy Research Establishment School and College
